title: GitHub Pull Request Review
description: Structured PR review output for gh-my-task review. Each inline comment MUST include a suggestion block or skip_suggestion:true with reason.

event.description: Review event type. Use COMMENT for general feedback, REQUEST_CHANGES when changes are required, APPROVE when the PR is ready to merge.

summary.description: Overall review body. MUST NOT contain ```suggestion blocks. Use plain text and Markdown prose only. Code suggestions belong exclusively in inline comments.

comments.description: Inline review comments. Each comment targets a specific line in the diff.

path.description: File path relative to repository root (e.g. src/foo.ts)

line.description: Line number in the diff hunk to attach the comment to. MUST be within the PR diff range.

side.description: RIGHT = new version of the file (post-change). LEFT = old version. Defaults to RIGHT.

start_line.description: Optional. Starting line for multi-line comments. Must be <= line.

body.description: Explanation text for this comment. Do NOT include the suggestion block here; set the suggestion field instead.

suggestion.description: Replacement code. Will be rendered as a ```suggestion block. REQUIRED unless skip_suggestion is true.

skip_suggestion.description: Set to true only when a code suggestion is genuinely impossible (e.g. design-level discussion). Requires reason.

reason.description: Required when skip_suggestion is true. Explain why no code suggestion is provided (e.g. 'design-discussion', 'architectural-concern').
